ColorInvo for Android · Updated September 12, 2026

ColorInvo stores your Taiwan mobile invoice carrier, barcode colors, widget settings, and a small wallpaper preview in private app storage. The app and its widget read the same saved settings on this device.

Only the photo you select through the system picker is read. Color extraction happens on device. The app does not upload photos or carrier settings, require an account, contain advertising or analytics, or sell personal data.

Android may back up these settings and the preview or transfer them to a new device according to your system settings. Google Play and Android may process downloads, diagnostics, and crash reports under their own policies and your settings.

You can change saved settings in the app. To delete local app data, use Android Settings → Apps → ColorInvo → Storage → Clear storage, or uninstall the app. Manage cloud backups separately in Android settings; a backup may restore data after reinstalling.

If you email support, your email address and message are used and retained as needed to respond to and track your request. Please leave your real carrier and private photos out of bug reports.

Contact: its.hsichen@gmail.com
Web policy: https://colorinvo.hsichen.dev/en/privacy
The website host may process IP addresses, user agents, and request times to operate and secure the site.

1. Enter the seven characters after the slash (eight characters total, such as /ABC1234).

2. Choose a style and import a wallpaper, or fine-tune the colors. Valid carriers with scanner-ready colors save automatically. Wait for “Synced”.

3. Touch and hold an empty area of your Home screen, open Widgets, and add ColorInvo. The steps vary by launcher. Resize the widget as needed; tap it to reopen the editor.

If scanning fails, try the Minimal style with dark bars and a light background. Avoid red bars and test with a store scanner before relying on a custom palette.

Support: its.hsichen@gmail.com
